page: Microsoft Azure E64bds_v5 is a memory-optimized virtual machine built on the Microsoft Hyper-V hypervisor. The instance is powered by an x86_64 Intel Xeon 8370C processor running at a base clock speed of 2.8 GHz. It provides 64 dedicated vCPUs mapped across 32 physical cores via simultaneous multithreading, supported by 48 MB of L3 cache, 1 MB of L2 cache per core, and 48 KB of L1 data cache. The system is equipped with 512.0 GB of memory, equating to an 8:1 memory-to-core ratio of 8.0 GB per vCPU. Attached local storage includes a 2577 GB solid-state drive with block storage capabilities, and the configuration supports Azure Premium Storage. The instance does not include a GPU or complimentary public IPv4 addresses.

Benchmark results demonstrate strong parallel computing and memory subsystem capabilities. The multi-core performance tests show high output, registering 62157.0 on stress-ng, 16801.0 on Geekbench multi-core, and 61312.34 on the PassMark CPU suite. Single-threaded metrics remain in the average tier, with Geekbench single-core at 1702.0 and stress-ng single-core at 1899.88. Memory bandwidth throughput reaches 303.98 GB/sec for uncached large block reads and 134.85 GB/sec for writes. Workload-specific benchmarks indicate rapid data processing, delivering 62.47 million operations per second on Redis SET tasks and a PassMark database score of 30809.25. CPU-based LLM inference performance drops sharply on larger architectures, recording 2.78 tokens per second on text generation with a 70B parameter model.

The hardware configuration offers high resource density for memory-bound and transactional services without the overhead of accelerator hardware. While single-thread instruction throughput is moderate, the combination of 512.0 GB of RAM, 64 vCPUs, and 2577 GB of integrated SSD storage provides sustained input and output capability for data-intensive enterprise workloads. This profile fits production relational databases, in-memory caches, distributed analytics nodes, and high-concurrency web applications.
description: Microsoft Azure E64bds_v5 is a memory-optimized virtual machine featuring 64 dedicated vCPUs and 32 physical cores powered by an Intel Xeon 8370C processor clocked at 2.8 GHz. Designed for data-heavy workloads, it includes 512.0 GB of system memory, maintaining an 8.0 GB per vCPU ratio, alongside a local 2577 GB SSD with Premium Storage support. The instance operates without discrete GPU accelerators. Benchmarks highlight upper-tier multi-threaded execution, high database throughput, and memory bandwidth exceeding 303 GB/sec for large block reads, alongside 62.47 million Redis SET operations per second. Single-core performance falls in the average category, making the instance less suited for clock-dependent single-threaded tasks. The substantial RAM allocation and high-speed local disk capacity make the E64bds_v5 appropriate for in-memory caching, large relational database engines, transactional backends, and intensive data processing.
